body.x: Sechang Instrument(representative Seung-jun Song, www.wepware.com) is presenting User-friendly Active Web Service 'Wepware' at CES 2012(Consumer Electronics Show 2012) held in Las Vegas, US from Jan 10 to 13 (local time).

(Pucture1: Seung-jun Song representative of Sechang Instrument explains User-friendly Web service Platform 'Active Web Service')Wepware can share contents of Web sites through SNS and community which user uses with method of WYSIWYG(What You See Is What You Get).Once setting the favor information or contents of sports and social commerce, user can utilize the information and contents with just one click continually.User can combine user's community with web page as application type , also user can monitor it by adding several apps."User can place web service or contents on designated spot of screen, and in case of web service added by need of user, it can be utilized for marketing" said Seung-jun Song representative of Sechang Instrument.Meanwhile, Incheon IT Promotion Agency(IITPA, Director Sung-kap Cho, www.iitpa.or.kr) have prepared exhaustively from prior meeting to on-the-site marketing including finding buyers, market research and others for CES held in Las vegas, US. IITPA has been supporting cracking American market of 8 export promising companies.Go to IITPA special page(Picture 3: Demonstration of 'WepWare')(Pictuer 4: Buyer gives some question to member of Sechang Instrument)(Picture 5: Sechang Instrument members who attend at CES 2012)
